_about: The mystery box (core/mystery_box.gd, game/mystery_box_node.gd). A spin costs `price` points, takes `spin_seconds` and offers a rolled gun for `take_seconds`: tier from `min_tier` up, luck = luck_base + luck_per_round x the round (never pony: that tier has no weight). After `moves_after` [fewest, most] spins a seagull carries the box to another of `spots` (island + at [x, z] from that island's middle) in `move_seconds`. It works without power. Game over puts it back on the first spot.
